business_overview.one_sentence: The group is mainly engaged in sale of software, hardware and system integration, with almost all customer revenue from Mainland China.
segments: Single operating segment: sale of software, hardware and system integration.
Investment properties generate small rental income.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue from software, hardware and system integration is mainly recognised when goods are transferred at a point in time; payment is generally due within 90 days from invoice, with some retention until quality conditions are satisfied.
business_notes: 2024 revenue from contracts with customers was HK$919.251m and rental income was HK$5.603m.
Mainland China external customer revenue was HK$920.245m; no single customer exceeded 10% of revenue.
Contracts in hand were HK$211.1m at year end, expected to complete within one year.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow stayed positive and capex was low, but reported profit includes bank interest, software-related government grants, investment property fair value losses, and 2022/2024 entrusted-loan impairment reversals; distributable cash profit is therefore set below reported profit and then haircut.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by listed parent, Hong Kong subsidiaries and Mainland operating subsidiaries; detachable cash haircut is therefore conservative.
Annual report discloses time deposits as seven days to six months but does not provide a detailed maturity ladder for each deposit.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not separately disclosed; purchases of PPE are low, so reported PPE purchases are used as a conservative maintenance capex proxy.
No direct disclosure found for legally distributable reserves or tax cost of upstreaming Mainland subsidiary cash.
